sources: RIDB campsite catalog for facility 232459 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: $30 a night per site (tent, walk-to and RV sites alike; group sites $75), plus recreation.gov's booking fee. $15 a night with a Senior or Access pass. Shenandoah charges $30 per private vehicle to enter, valid seven consecutive days.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232459 (fee description) + /rates (2026 Peak Season Mar 25 - Nov 29: STANDARD NONELECTRIC $30) + https://www.nps.gov/shen/planyourvisit/fees.htm (private vehicle $30, seven days)

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232459 ('$15.00 per night/per site with an Access (disability/golden age) or Senior Pass')

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232459 (notice: 'There are no RV hook-ups provided. There is a dump/fill station with potable water available.')

values.note: Showers are coin-operated. Wi-Fi only at Byrd Visitor Center and Big Meadows Lodge; cell reception at the amphitheater.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232459 (description: flush toilets, showers, dump station; amenities: Coin Showers, Drinking Water, Laundry Facilities, General Store/Camping Supplies; notices name the campstore)

values.note: 2026 dates (March 25 to November 29); NPS says dates are subject to change.

season.source: https://www.nps.gov/shen/planyourvisit/hours.htm (Campgrounds table: Big Meadows 2026 opening March 25, closing November 29; last updated 2026-09-22)

values.note: All sites are reservation only. Most open 6 months ahead; some are released 2 weeks before arrival and the rest 4 days before. Rangers can make limited reservations on site (card only), not guaranteed.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232459 (fee description: '100% reservation only ... majority of sites can be reserved up to 6 months out. Other sites will be released 2 weeks prior ... remaining sites released 4 days prior') + https://www.nps.gov/shen/planyourvisit/campground-reservations.htm

values.note: 215 bookable sites (163 standard, 50 tent-only, 2 group) plus 9 management sites. Listed lengths are the trailer length and allow a tow vehicle up to 20 ft on the driveway; the 70-ft figure is on the pull-throughs in loops F-I.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for facility 232459 (RIDB, fetched 2026-10-20: 28 pull-through sites, Max Vehicle Length up to 70) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232459 notice on listed trailer lengths

summary: Confirmed $30 base, no hookups (water/sewer now recorded false), Senior/Access pass ($15). Added season 2026 Mar 25-Nov 29, reservation-only (fcfs never), 6-month window with 2-week/4-day release waves, $30/7-day park entrance, facilities, site count/length/pull-through. Not stated in prose: max stay (rec.gov rule field says 30 nights, not written), wifi at the campground, operating status.
